subcategory: Animated gallery grid with CTA elements and blur transitions
use_cases: Product showcase sections on SaaS landing pages
Portfolio or visual gallery displays for creative portfolios
Marketing sections combining imagery with call-to-action messaging
Image-based feature highlights on e-commerce product pages
Animated gallery sections on media and content platforms
ai_summary: An animated CTA section featuring a mosaic-style gallery grid with staggered reveal animations triggered on scroll. Uses Framer Motion for smooth blur-to-focus transitions and spring physics, creating an engaging visual experience. Designed to showcase visual content while driving user engagement through combined gallery and call-to-action elements.
